name: Mayonaka Garan
source:
Mayonaka Garan is set in the rural Japanese village of Daiusu, where a community of Christians has lived in seclusion for many generations. Hamomoru Tachibana is invited to this village as a guest. The village has just finished building its long-dreamed-of cathedral, and the mood is celebratory. The villagers wish to use this moment to enter the modern world of the 1920s. As part of this, Hamomoru is tasked with archiving the history and legends of Daiusu. 

Located in a secluded part of Japan, the village, due to a long history of oppression, has seen its faith take a peculiar turn.
The Faith of the Saint.
The villagers have come to project their hopes for salvation onto a "Saint" who came from the outside world.

This tradition of treasuring friendly visitors seems perfectly suited to modernizing the village.
And yet.
Just as the village begins to come together, a restless shroud still hangs over it. Individual motives begin to clash, and miracles occur as if to make a mockery of everything...

What will become of Daiusu's attempt to enter the wider world?

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/carpefulgur/the-midnight-sanctuary]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
《真夜中伽蓝》的故事发生在日本乡村大臼村，那里的基督徒社区世世代代都过着隐居生活。Hamomoru Tachibana被邀请到这个村庄作为客人。村子里刚刚建成了梦想已久的大教堂，人们都在庆祝。村民们希望利用这一刻进入1920年代的现代世界。作为其中的一部分，Hamomoru的任务是归档大牛的历史和传说。

这个位于日本偏僻地区的村庄，由于长期的压迫历史，其信仰发生了奇特的转变。
圣人的信仰。
村民们纷纷将救赎的希望寄托在一位来自外界的“圣人”身上。

这种珍视友好游客的传统似乎非常适合村庄的现代化建设。
然而。
就在村庄开始团结起来的时候，一层不安的裹尸布仍然笼罩着它。个人的动机开始发生冲突，奇迹的出现仿佛是在嘲笑一切……

大牛试图进入更广阔的世界，结果会怎样呢？

[编辑自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/carpefulgur/the-midnight-sanctuary]Kickstarter[/url]]
